locator: Table 1 and its unit-conversion note, PDF page 11 (printed page 10)
original_sources: Min Tsung-tien (1984), pp. 37-52; compilation by Ts'ui-jung Liu (1991)
original_unit: standardized shih catties per shih mou
role: field-yield mechanism benchmark, not a population target or whole-location yield override
limitations: Source describes estimates as rough; geographic coverage and cultivation intensity vary
The source explicitly uses a 0.6 kg catty; substituting a present-day 0.5 kg unit is incorrect here
Moisture is unspecified; a dry-matter conversion requires a labelled assumption and sensitivity tests
Single harvest yields are not annual food per total location area
Adoption area, seed, losses, milling, nutrition and maintenance must be accounted for
Later Ming and Qing values are progression evidence, not starting yields
